Class PasswordResetService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.auth.PasswordResetService
@Service public class PasswordResetService extends Object
Service for password recovery: issues the single-use link a client is emailed, and changes the password when that link is used.

  • Constructor Details

    • PasswordResetService

      public PasswordResetService(ClientRepository clientRepository, ClientCredentialsRepository credentialsRepository, PasswordResetTokenRepository tokenRepository, ClientSessionRepository sessionRepository, org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher eventPublisher, @Value("${app.password-reset.token-ttl-minutes}") long tokenTtlMinutes, @Value("${app.password-reset.link-base-url}") String linkBaseUrl)
      Constructs a new PasswordResetService with the specified dependencies.
      Parameters:
      clientRepository - the repository for managing client entities
      credentialsRepository - the repository for managing client credentials
      tokenRepository - the repository storing the hash of each issued reset token
      sessionRepository - the repository used to sign the client out once the password changes
      passwordEncoder - the password encoder for hashing the new password
      eventPublisher - publishes the reset link so it is delivered once the token has committed
      tokenTtlMinutes - how long a reset link stays usable, in minutes
      linkBaseUrl - the frontend page the link opens; the token is appended as a query parameter

  • Method Details

    • requestReset

      @Transactional public void requestReset(String email)
      Issues a reset link for the client with this email, replacing any earlier link. Does nothing for an email that has no resettable client, and never tells the caller which case it was, so this cannot be used to find out which emails are registered.
      Parameters:
      email - the email address the reset was requested for

    • validateToken

      public void validateToken(String token)
      Checks that a reset link can still be used, without spending it.
      Parameters:
      token - the token from the emailed reset link
      Throws:
      InvalidResetTokenException - if the token is unknown, expired, already used or replaced

    • resetPassword

      @Transactional public void resetPassword(String token, String newPassword)
      Sets a new password using the token from a reset link. The link is spent, the client's failed login attempts are cleared along with any lock they caused, and every existing session ends.
      Parameters:
      token - the token from the emailed reset link
      newPassword - the raw password to set
      Throws:
      InvalidResetTokenException - if the token is unknown, expired or already used
